audit: PhiUSIIL and PhreshPhish label mapping, A0/A1/A2 provenance and E1-E8 end-to-end integrity

scope.notebook_execution: No notebook executed or modified in this audit; existing executed notebooks inspected for execution counts/outputs. A2 extractor smoke-run was executed from the real shared features.py module.

label_integrity.reason: Current pipeline mapping verified: PhiUSIIL y_phish=1-label; PhreshPhish benign=0/phish=1. The mapping is verified against stored source values, not independent adjudication of source ground truth.

A2_identity.reason: Current 18-name feature list/order is asserted and used for PhiUSIIL and PhreshPhish; deterministic raw URL extractor smoke test returned 18 ordered fields. Same-name equality with precomputed columns is not supported: sample exact agreement is 0% for NoOfLettersInURL, LetterRatioInURL, NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL, SpacialCharRatioInURL; DomainLength exact agreement 6.555%.

train_test_isolation.reason: Current E5 fit passes selected train X/y to model.fit and test data only to prediction; A2 values are deterministic per-row URL computations. E6 fits only source train and predicts source test and target. A0/A1 are inherited stored features; the upstream creation scope cannot be verified, and random-row split has canonical URL overlap.

causal_ceiling_effect_support.reason: Full-data high solo AUCs and near-ceiling in-corpus metrics show separability/saturation, but the feature producer/label provenance is unknown and no design identifies that it caused the ceiling. A1-A0 estimates only a small six-feature group contrast; no causal mechanism is isolated.

feature_screen_and_fitting_scope.E1_single_feature_auc_screen: whole dataset; before split; target labels used to calculate AUC for descriptive audit
feature_screen_and_fitting_scope.historical_probe_TLDLegitimateProb: whole PhiUSIIL labels before experiment split; original Phresh train-partition labels before a later resplit; proven leakage in those probes only
feature_screen_and_fitting_scope.current_E5_A0_A1_fit: model estimator train IDs and labels only; stored upstream feature-generation information scope unknown
feature_screen_and_fitting_scope.current_E5_A2_fit: feature extraction URL-only and row-local; estimator fit uses train fold only
feature_screen_and_fitting_scope.E6_transfer_fit: PhiUSIIL random seed-42 train fold only; no target fit/adaptation; target feature transform is deterministic row-local A2
feature_screen_and_fitting_scope.E7_threshold_selection: validation labels/scores; frozen before test; E7 package documents validation-only but code location in package imports local implementation
feature_screen_and_fitting_scope.E8_error_analysis: consumes saved E4 test predictions; no model refit/tuning

caveats: No producer source or provenance metadata for most precomputed PhiUSIIL columns was found in local executable files; feature provenance is unknown, not assumed safe or leaky.

Current feature screen and model fitting are different stages: AUC screen uses all labels for description; model fits use selected train folds. Whole-data screening may inform post-hoc narrative but it did not automatically fit or mutate model features.
E5 A0/A1 stored columns may embed corpus or label-dependent signals even though current estimator fitting is train-only.
E1 cleaning-report table is inconsistent with actual drop code and actual dropped list; rely on executable code for what current pipeline actually drops.
The v8 manuscript has some numbers from the v8 E5 results, but older E3 CSV metrics cannot be interpreted as phishing-positive without label transformation/recalculation.
Legacy target-encoding probe is a separate exploratory code path, not evidence the current stored source column is generated by that exact formula.
